title: The 9/11 Commission Report
summary: Final report of the bipartisan National Commission on Terrorist Attacks Upon the United States. Establishes that 19 al-Qaeda hijackers carried out the attacks and catalogues institutional failures (FBI–CIA info sharing, watchlisting, FAA/NORAD response, the August 6 2001 PDB). On insider trading it is explicit: exhaustive SEC/FBI investigations 'uncovered no evidence that anyone with advance knowledge of the attacks profited through securities transactions.' Commission chairs Kean and Hamilton later charged the CIA obstructed the Commission.
tldr: The Commission concluded 19 al-Qaeda operatives carried out the 9/11 attacks (funded with $400,000–$500,000) after years of institutional failures across the FBI, CIA, and aviation security — and stated exhaustively that no one with advance knowledge of the attacks profited from insider trading.
ai_summary:
AI review of the full 9/11 Commission Report PDF (govinfo.library.unt.edu/911, 303,000+ words), read in full:
- Scope and scale: bipartisan commission created by Congress; the report establishes that 19 al-Qaeda operatives carried out the attacks, "funded by al Qaeda, either through wire transfers or cash provided by KSM," with the plot costing "$400,000–$500,000" over nearly two years.
- Insider trading — verbatim from page 172: "Exhaustive investigations by the Securities and Exchange Commission, FBI, and other agencies have uncovered no evidence that anyone with advance knowledge of the attacks profited through securities transactions." The report also notes the origin of the attack money could not be determined.
- Missed warnings: the report reproduces discussion of the August 6, 2001 Presidential Daily Brief article titled "Bin Ladin Determined to Strike in US," and catalogues the FBI–CIA information-sharing breakdowns, watchlisting failures, and FAA/NORAD response gaps.
- Caveat on the record summary: the document verifies the core claims (19 hijackers, PDB, institutional failures, insider-trading quote verbatim). The summary's final clause — that Commission chairs Kean and Hamilton "later charged the CIA obstructed the Commission" — is not in the report text (a grep for "obstruct" returns only unrelated Iraq-war and stairway-evacuation passages); that charge was made in their later public statements, outside this document.
